questions_and_answers.question_text: How do you say "Saturday of this week" and "Saturday of last week"?
Which day do most Chinese consider the first day of the week?
What is the general object used with chī?
In what sense is a biànfàn "simple"?
Give the Chinese for "of this week," "of next week," and "of last week."
What does a Chinese family meal usually consist of?
Write the Chinese for "I would like to invite you and your wife to come to our house for a simple meal."

answers.answer_text: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nín hé nín fūren dào wǒmen jiā lái chī ge biànfàn.

questions_and_answers.question_text: What is the literal meaning of fàn?
Why is biànfàn used in an invitation?

answers.answer_text: As a modest description of a meal served in the home.

articles.text:
1. A: Huáng Kēzhǎng, nín xiàge      Section Chief Huáng, are you free
      Xīngqīliù yǒu gōngfu ma?       Saturday of next week?
   A: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nín hé nín      I would like to invite you and your
      fūren dào wǒmen jiā lái        wife to come to our house for a
      chī ge biànfàn.                simple meal.

Notes on No. 1

Xiàge Xīngqīliù means "Saturday of next week." "Saturday of this week" is zhèige Xīngqīliù, and "Saturday of last week" is shàngge Xīngqīliù.

The words "this," "next," and "last" in English are often ambiguous. In Chinese, however, zhèige usually means "of this week"; xiàge, "of next week"; and shàngge, "of last week." But ambiguities do sometimes arise.

Some Chinese consider that the week begins on Sunday. Probably most Chinese, however, consider Monday the first day of the week.

Chī ge biànfàn: Here the verb chī, "to eat (something)," takes the object (yí)ge biànfàn, "a simple/informal family meal." When talking about the general activity of eating, however, use chī with the general object fàn, literally "(cooked) rice": chī fàn, "to eat."

The word biànfàn is used as a modest description in inviting guests for a meal served in the home. The meal is generally "simple" only in the sense of not being a banquet. A Chinese family meal usually consists of several dishes plus a soup.
